size.description: [width, height] in metres; origin at (0,0) bottom-left

features.description: Hills, ridges, table mountains (height > 0) and basins, valleys, gorges (height < 0), added together

at.description: Centre of a round hill, mesa or basin

points.description: Instead of `at`: a ridge, valley or gorge along this polyline; `radius` is then its half-width

anyOf.description: [x, y] in metres; x = east, y = north

items.description: [x, y], or [x, y, level]: the absolute height the feature pulls the ground to there (interpolated along the line)

area.description: Instead of `at`: a plateau (or basin) filling this polygon; `radius` is then the width of the slope beyond its rim

items.description: [x, y] in metres; x = east, y = north

radius.description: How far the feature reaches (its foot): from its centre, its line, or (an area) its rim

height.description: Metres added at the top (negative: a basin, valley or gorge)

level.description: Instead of `height`: the absolute height the ground is pulled to at the top (a flat valley floor, a terrace, a levelled yard)

direction.description: With a level: only lower the ground to it (down: valleys, gorges), only raise it (up), or both

shape.description: bump: a smooth Gaussian rise, ~5% left at `radius`; mesa: a table mountain — a flat top, a sheer cliff and a talus slope below

plateau.description: mesa at a point or along a line: share of the radius that is flat on top

cliff.description: mesa: share of the height that falls as a sheer cliff (the rest is the talus slope)

rough.description: How ragged the outline is, 0 (round, straight) to 1 (deeply lobed, like weathered sandstone)

rock.description: Colour of bare rock on steep ground (default grey "#9c968a"); e.g. "#b9a582" for sandstone

areas.description: Ground cover painted on the terrain inside polygons: fields, meadows, vineyards, forest floor, sand, spoil heaps…; later areas lie on top

cover.description: What covers the ground there; each has its own seasonal colours

items.description: [x, y] in metres; x = east, y = north

rows.description: Draw the cover in stripes running this way (degrees counter-clockwise from east): furrows, crop strips, vine rows

water.description: Rivers and streams (lines with a width, flowing from the first point to the last) and lakes and ponds (closed outlines with a level); carved into the terrain, crossed by bridges

kind.description: river / stream: a line flowing from its first point to its last; lake / pond: a closed outline

name.description: Shown when inspecting; default from the id ("kirnitzsch" → "Kirnitzsch")

anyOf.description: [x, y] in metres; x = east, y = north

at.description: [x, y] in metres; x = east, y = north

z.description: Water surface height here (m); between such points it is interpolated

width.description: River or stream: width here (m); interpolated between points

points.description: River: its course (smoothed into curves); lake: its shore, as a polygon (smoothed)

width.description: River / stream width (m); default 40 for a river, 5 for a stream

level.description: Lake / pond surface height (m); default just below the lowest ground on its shore

depth.description: Depth at the middle (m); default river 3, stream 0.8, lake 5, pond 1.5

bank.description: m of sloping bank beyond the water's edge; default river 14, stream 5, lake 10, pond 5

clearance.description: How high bridges must keep above the water (m); default river 5, stream 1.2, lake 2, pond 1

road.description: freight only: the road along the back of the dock, where lorries stop to load and unload; default the nearest one within 30 m

group.description: Platforms of one station on several tracks (both tracks of a double-track line, a junction's many platforms): stations with the same group share their ways in, joined by an underpass, and people change between them there

train.description: Train type id: regional-3, express-6, freight-10, freight-4, tram-2, railcar-1, railcar-2, s-bahn-dd, intercity-dd, eurocity-7, freight-coal, freight-timber, freight-tank, freight-container, freight-box, shunter

route.description: Ordered track ids; consecutive ids must share a junction

stops.description: Station ids, and off-layout place ids reached by a track at an end of the route that leaves the board

stabled.description: Trains standing still on sidings — in yards, depots and stations — for show; no service may run over them

track.description: Track the consist stands on (a siding no service runs over)

train.description: Train type: regional-3, express-6, freight-10, freight-4, tram-2, railcar-1, railcar-2, s-bahn-dd, intercity-dd, eurocity-7, freight-coal, freight-timber, freight-tank, freight-container, freight-box, shunter

cars.description: Vehicles in the consist, locomotive included; default the train type's

loco.description: false: no locomotive — a rake of coaches or wagons waiting to be collected

color.description: Colour of its coaches or wagons; default the train type's

load.description: Goods heaped in its wagons (shown in open, hopper, flat and container wagons), e.g. "coal"

reverse.description: Turn it round: the locomotive at the end toward lower s

roads.description: Road network: crossroads form automatically, level crossings where a road meets a track at grade

parking.description: Street parking: a strip of parking bays between the carriageway and the sidewalk, left/right of increasing s

road.description: Road this one starts (from) or ends (to) on, forming a T-junction

at.description: Arc length s on that road (m), or "start" / "end" to join at one of its ends (a corner)

paths.description: Footpaths: junctions form automatically, zebra crossings where a path crosses a road, foot crossings over tracks

name.description: Name for addresses and places to visit; default from the id

path.description: Path this one starts (from) or ends (to) on, forming a T-junction

road.description: Road whose edge this path starts or ends at, joining its sidewalk on that side

station.description: Station whose platform this path starts or ends at (people walk on to the platform there)

at.description: With path or road: arc length s on it (m), or "start" / "end"

trafficLights.description: Traffic lights at road junctions: opposite approaches share a green, each direction in turn

at.description: Where the road junction is: the nearest junction of three or more roads within 15 m gets the lights

green.description: Longest green for each direction (s); it ends sooner when nothing more is coming and someone waits on red

parking.description: Car parks: rows of bays along an aisle, joined to a road by a driveway

name.description: Shown as its address; default from the id ("station-car-park" → "Station Car Park")

spaces.description: Number of bays, in two rows either side of an aisle

rotation.description: Degrees counter-clockwise from east that the entrance faces; default toward the road it joins

road.description: Road its driveway joins; default the nearest

busStops.description: Bus stops beside roads, on one side or both

name.description: Shown on the stop and in journeys; default from the id ("market-square" → "Market Square")

at.description: s along the road (m) of the stop's sign; buses stop with their front door beside it

side.description: Which side of the road (left/right of increasing s) has a stop; buses drive on the right, so the right side serves buses going toward increasing s

shelter.description: Draw a shelter behind the kerb (left out where something already stands there)

busLines.description: Bus lines: buses calling at stops in order along the roads; people ride them like trains

name.description: Shown on the buses and in journeys, e.g. "3" or "Harbour Hopper"; default from the id

stops.description: Bus stop ids (or off-layout place ids reached by road) in the order the buses call; they take the quickest way along the roads between them

mode.description: shuttle: there and back along the list, turning round after the last stop; loop: from the last stop back to the first

count.description: Buses on the line, spread evenly along it

dwell.description: s a bus waits at each stop (longer while people get on and off)

vehicle.description: Object id drawn as the bus

color.description: Colour of the line's buses; default one per line

offLayout.description: Places off the board, reached by tracks, roads and paths that leave it (end on its edge): stops for services and bus lines, and destinations for errands

name.description: Shown in journeys and timetables; default from the id ("neustadt" → "Neustadt")

track.description: A track that leaves the board toward the place

road.description: A road that leaves the board toward the place (cars and buses; people on foot along its sidewalks)

path.description: A footpath that leaves the board toward the place

end.description: Which end of the line leaves the board, if both do

distance.description: m from the board's edge to the place along this way

via.description: The lines leading off the board to it, each with the distance beyond the edge

jobs.description: Posts there that residents of the board may hold (they commute)

titles.description: Job titles, as for buildings: the last fills the rest

visits.description: How often people go there on a visit; 1 ≈ one landmark on the board

supplies.description: Goods sent out from there (loads per hour), by freight train or lorry

freight.description: Deliveries: goods supplied and demanded by buildings and off-layout places move by road and by freight train

vehicles.description: Delivery vans and lorries; default a few of each when anything needs delivering by road. Idle ones drive about until given a job

name.description: What these vehicles are called, e.g. "Post van"; default "Delivery van" or "Lorry" (from the object)

object.description: Object id drawn as the vehicle

color.description: Colour of these vehicles; default one picked per vehicle

count.description: How many people live on the board; default as many as the accommodation holds (at most 600)

cars.description: Share of people who own a car (when there is parking near home)

vehicles.description: Object ids of the residents' own vehicles, picked at random

cars.description: Through traffic: vehicles driving about at random, not owned by residents; default about one per 200 m of road (at most 30)

vehicles.description: Object ids for through traffic, picked at random (repeat an id to make it more common); real buses run on busLines

objects.description: Custom scenery objects for this layout, by id; they may also redefine built-in ids

description.description: What it is, for people and LLMs reading the layout

building.description: Makes every placement of this object a building people can live in, work at or visit

functions.description: accommodation: people live here; workplace: people work here; landmark: people visit it (a church, a shop, a pub)

residents.description: accommodation: how many people live here (default 3)

jobs.description: workplace: how many people work here (default 3)

titles.description: workplace: job titles; the first job gets the first title and so on, the last title fills the rest (default ["Employee"])

kind.description: What sort of place it is, shown with its address, e.g. "Church" or "Bakery"

door.description: Entrance [x, y] in the object frame; default the middle of the front (+x) face

supplies.description: Goods it sends out, in loads per hour, e.g. { "food": 8 } for a farm; lorries and vans collect them

demands.description: Goods it needs delivered, in loads per hour, e.g. { "food": 3, "mail": 1 } for a shop

shape.description: box | pyramid (a box narrowing to a point) | gable (triangular roof prism, ridge along x) | cylinder | cone | sphere | panel (only the box's front (+x) face, one-sided: windows, doors, signs)

at.description: Bottom centre of the part in the object frame [x front, y left, z up] (m); negative z sinks it into the ground

size.description: Extent [along x, along y, height] in metres, before rotation

rotate.description: Degrees about x, then y, then z (right-handed), pivoting on `at`

color.description: "#rrggbb", a named colour, or "tint": the per-placement colour picked from the object's `tint`

winter.description: Colour used in winter instead, e.g. "snow" on a roof

seasons.description: Only draw this part in these seasons

taper.description: box, pyramid, cylinder, cone: top size as a fraction of the bottom, one number or [x, y]. Defaults: box and cylinder 1, pyramid and cone 0

ridge.description: gable: where the ridge sits across the width, 0..1 (0.5 centred; 0 or 1 makes a lean-to)

glow.description: Glows warmly at night (default: true for colours "window" and "lamp")

smoke.description: A chimney: smoke rises from the top of this part when the placement smokes

grid.description: Number of copies along x, y and z (windows, posts, columns)

step.description: Spacing between grid copies [x, y, z] (m)

mirror.description: Also draw mirror images: x flips front↔back (x → −x), y flips left↔right (y → −y), xy both

tint.description: Colours for parts coloured "tint": one is picked per placement. A palette list (walls, roofs, foliage, needles, people; foliage and needles follow the season) or an array of colours

smoke.description: Share of placements whose chimney parts smoke (a placement's `smoke` overrides)

maxSlope.description: Steepest ground (degrees) a scatter will put this object on

object.description: Place one object (built-in or from `objects`) at `at`

scatter.description: Scatter many objects, picked at random from these ids (repeat an id to make it more common)

at.description: object: where it stands. scatter: circle centre (omit with radius for the whole map)

area.description: scatter: a polygon to fill instead of a circle

items.description: [x, y] in metres; x = east, y = north

rows.description: scatter: set items out in straight rows (vines, orchard trees, tents) instead of at random

angle.description: Direction the rows run (degrees counter-clockwise from east); items face along them

spacing.description: m between rows (`spacing` is then the distance between items along a row)

rotation.description: object: degrees counter-clockwise from east that the object's front (+x) faces; default 0

face.description: object: turn the front toward the nearest track ("track"), the nearest road ("road") or a point [x, y]; overrides rotation

anyOf.description: [x, y] in metres; x = east, y = north

scale.description: object: size factor (default 1). scatter: [min, max] range (default [0.8, 1.2])

z.description: object: absolute base height (m); default the ground (or the platform top on a platform)

color.description: object: colour for its "tint" parts; default one picked from the object's tint list

smoke.description: object: whether its chimneys smoke; default by the object's smoke share

name.description: object: the building's name or address, e.g. "St. Mary's Church" or "4 Mill Lane"; default an address from the nearest street

building.description: object: what this building is for, overriding the object's own `building` (functions, residents, jobs, titles, kind)

titles.description: workplace: job titles; the first job gets the first title and so on, the last title fills the rest (default ["Employee"])

kind.description: What sort of place it is, shown with its address, e.g. "Church" or "Bakery"
